query: Two applications share a component package but have distinct approved brands and separate design contracts. The shared package proposes changing the card surface treatment. Advise how each application should evaluate it.
expected_behavior: Resolves each application's approved intent independently
Evaluates the shared implementation change against both contracts and existing approval evidence
Does not treat shared package ownership as authorization to copy one app's treatment into the other
Identifies any conflict or required app-specific variant explicitly
